 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). From the repository root:
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+To run a single test file or a single test:
+
+```sh
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
